description: Answers the URL a form or automation tool POSTs each new lead to as JSON (a Make "HTTP: Make a request" step after Facebook Lead Ads "Watch new leads", a Zapier webhook step, a website form). Each lead lands on the Leads page within seconds and starts the lead follow-ups. The first call creates it. source (optional): where the leads come from, e.g. angi; it is added to the URL so each lead shows as from that source. Without it, a Facebook Lead Ads lead shows as Facebook on its own and any other as a lead form. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: lead_intake_address
title: Get the lead intake URL
